Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment
Substitute Narrative, Analysis and Plans
212 East Ohio Street
DX-12 District to DX-12 District (Type 1)

Cubed Investments LLC is the “Applicant” for a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment for the subject property
located at 212 East Ohio Street from the DX-12 Downtown Mixed-Use District to the DX-12 Downtown
Mixed-Use District (Type 1) to redevelop the existing 5-story building and allow a change of use from ground
floor commercial and office use above to ground floor commercial and residential use above.

The site is bounded by an 18-foot public alley to the north, residential property to the east, East Ohio Street
to the south, and commercial property to the west. The subject property consists of approximately 5,280
square feet of site area and is improved with a commercial building which occupies substantially alt of the
site. The existing building contains approximately 31,680 square feet of floor area and currently operates
with a restaurant on the ground floor and office space above. There are no off-street vehicular parking
spaces on site. The property is a transit-served location based on its proximity to the CTA Red Line station
entrance at Grand Avenue and the Grand Avenue bus corridor.

The Applicant proposes to complete a rehabilitation of the existing building to upgrade aged and
substandard components of the structure and convert the 2nd through Sth floors to residential use. The
building will contain a total of 28 dwelling units and the existing restaurant will continue operating in the
ground floor commercial space. The Applicant proposes to add 28 bicycle parking spaces within the existing
building. The building footprint will remain unchanged. The Applicant is seeking all relief necessary, as
allowed by the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, for the attached plans.
